item.title: Where Detroit Red Wings are with Simon Edvinsson 2 weeks from deadline
item.description: TAMPA, FL - The stalemate between the Detroit Red Wings and Simon Edvinsson has two weeks on the clock before a deadline that will cost the player the entire 2026-27 season. Interim Red Wings general manager Shawn Horcoff said this week while the team was in Florida that he remains committed to signing the 23-year-old defenseman. But with the Dec. 1 deadline closing in, he is, naturally, also listening to any and all calls regarding a possible trade. Edvinsson's agent, J.P. Barry, told the Free Press that he is "talking to Shawn daily about solutions." If it ends up in a trade, it could bring the Wings what they really need. More: Red Wings still trying to become winning team 'after all these years' Edvinsson is quite an asset: A 6-foot-6, 220-plus pound defenseman who can skate and make plays with the puck. He had nine goals and 25 points in 72 games in 2025-26, his second full season in the NHL. The emergence of defensemen Anton Johansson and William Wallinder have helped offset how much the Wings have missed Edvinsson, whom former general manager Steve Yzerman selected at No. 6 in the 2021 draft. Edvinsson could bring in a trade what the Wings desperately need most of all: help at the center position. Emmitt Finnie has done his best centering the top line since Dylan Larkin left the team Oct. 29 to wait out a trade, but the Wings really need a bona fide top-line middle man if they are to ignite a chance of making the playoffs this season and end a 10-year drought. Giving up a young defenseman of Edvinsson's caliber is not ideal, but it serves neither side to have him miss an entire NHL season. If the Wings can flip him for a skilled center, be he on the younger side or in his prime, that's a scenario that could best serve both sides. Contact Helene St. James at Hstjames@freepress.com. Read more on the Detroit Red Wings and sign up for our Red Wings newsletter . item.title: Steelers’ Quarterback Future Takes Intriguing Turn in New Projection
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers are facing a lot of unknowns following the 2026 NFL season. One of the biggest question marks for the future comes at the quarterback position. Aaron Rodgers announced before this season that the 2026 campaign would be his last as an NFL quarterback. He sounds ready and prepared to head off into retirement, start a family with his wife, and leave football behind. Should he follow through on that expectation, the Steelers would need to find a new quarterback. Currently, Pittsburgh has two young options on its roster. Both Drew Allar and Will Howard are fighting to have a shot at being the long-term option. However, there is a good chance that the Steelers will consider outside options during the 2027 NFL offseason. Keeping all of that in mind, a new prediction has been made that would bring a massive quarterback steal to Pittsburgh. Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy looks on during the second half against the New England Patriots at Gillette Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Eric Canha-Imagn Images Pittsburgh Steelers Land Surprising New Quarterback Prediction Bleacher Report’s Brent Sobleski has released a new mock draft. In that mock draft, he has Notre Dame quarterback CJ Carr falling to the Steelers with the No. 26 overall pick. “The Pittsburgh Steelers could realistically decide they prefer Drew Allar’s development and allow the 2026 third-round draft pick to start next season. As of now, Aaron Rodgers’ retirement is the only inevitability regarding the situation,” Sobleski wrote . “So, the Steelers invest in the quarterback position again to ensure it’s addressed long term. Allar can then compete with Notre Dame’s CJ Carr if the organization likes both that much.” Carr has put together another strong season with the Fighting Irish this year. He has completed 67.6 percent of his pass attempts for 2,168 yards, 21 touchdowns, and an interception, while also running for 89 yards and three more scores. Back in the 2025 season with Notre Dame, Carr threw for 2,741 yards, 24 touchdowns, and six interceptions, completing 66.6 percent of his passes. He also ran for 33 yards and scored three more touchdowns on the ground. If Carr were to fall to the Steelers late in the first round, they shouldn’t think twice about selecting him. Carr has the potential to be a long-term star at the NFL level. Expect to hear plenty of rumors and a lot of speculation about Pittsburgh’s quarterback plan as the offseason draws closer. Carr is a name worth keeping a close eye on as a potential option for the Steelers in the 2027 NFL Draft. item.title: Donovan Mitchell Wants Mavericks Game Canceled After Cavaliers Get Stuck In Miami
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images The Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop for all airports on Friday afternoon, and the Cleveland Cavaliers were among those affected. The Cavaliers were scheduled for a back-to-back on the road against the Miami Heat on Friday and then at home against the Dallas Mavericks on Saturday. According to Chris Fedor , the Cavaliers had planned on leaving Miami late Friday night, but that plan had to be scrapped. They could only fly back to Cleveland on Saturday morning, and Donovan Mitchell made it clear after the 133-121 loss to the Heat at Kaseya Center that this was far from ideal. “This is unprecedented,” Mitchell said. “Back-to-back. Three-hour flight. It was already going to be a tough one. But if they say we have to play then we have to play.” The Cavaliers took a 9 a.m. flight out of Miami on Saturday, and that game against the Mavericks tips off at Rocket Arena at 7:30 p.m. That is rough, and Mitchell was asked if he’d prefer the NBA cancel the game against the Mavericks. “Me, personally, yeah, for sure,” Mitchell said. Unfortunately for Mitchell and the Cavaliers, that game won’t be canceled. They have to suck it up and play. The FAA issued this group stop at 3:54 p.m. on Friday after experiencing instability in radar and communications involving Air Traffic Control Centers and Terminal Radar Approach Control facilities. It was deemed an extraordinary circumstance. This was just the third time this century that a group stop had been issued. The first time was after the 9/11 terror attack and the second was in January 2023. Thousands of flights were canceled on Friday, but the ground stop was lifted at 8:15 p.m. So, departures resumed at night, but Fedor reports the Cavaliers couldn’t secure a new pilot until Saturday morning. They’ll be heading to the arena for the game against the Mavericks not long after landing, and Mitchell, in his 10th season in the NBA, has never encountered anything like this. “Never in my time in the league,” Mitchell said. “I think the craziest travel thing I’ve ever had was the COVID situation. Make adjustments. Figure it out. Go from there.” The Cavaliers go into that Mavericks game in rough shape, as is. They have lost five of their last seven games to drop to 6-7. Mitchell had 25 points (9-21 FG), four rebounds, and seven assists against the Heat. We haven’t really seen the best version of the seven-time All-Star this season, and the Cavaliers will be in trouble if this continues. They made it to the Eastern Conference Finals in 2026, and another deep playoff run isn’t looking likely in 2027.

item.title: Catchings, Cain serve as 1-2 punch for Georgia as Bulldogs pull comeback win over North Carolina
item.description: ATHENS, GA - NOVEMBER 09: Forward Kanon Catchings #6 of the Georgia Bulldogs celebrates with teammate guard Marcus Millender #4 of the Georgia Bulldogs during the college basketball game between the Florida Gulf Coast University Eagles and the Georgia Bulldogs on November 09, 2026, at Stegeman Coliseum in Athens, GA. (Photo by Jeffrey Vest/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) Icon Sportswire via Getty Images CHAPEL HILL, N.C. (AP) — Kanon Catchings totaled 22 points, Blue Cain scored 20 points and Georgia staged a late rally to beat North Carolina 78-70 on Friday night to end the Tar Heels’ 21-game home win streak. Marcus Millender added 17 points for the Bulldogs, who are off to a 4-0 start for the third straight year. Terrence Brown scored 21 points, Neo Avdalas 14 and reserve Isaiah Denis 11 for North Carolina (3-1). Georgia outscored North Carolina 20-8 in the last 6 minutes to get the win. Catchings made two free throws with 2:11 left to put Georgia ahead for good, 69-68. He followed with a deep 3-pointer from the left baseline with 1:44 left. Sayon Keita’s dunk 20 seconds later reduced the Tar Heels deficit to 72-70, but Cain ended all NC hopes with a 3 with 1:01 left. Maximo Adams converted a three-point play with 2:49 left to play in the first half to give the Tar Heels a 31-29 lead. Georgia responded with a Catchings 3 that led to a 9-0 Bulldogs run. Catchings made another 3 wrapped around one from Brady Dunlap and Georgia went to intermission with the largest lead for either team, 38-31. The Tar Heels emerged from the break and outscored Georgia 17-7 in the first 5 1/2 minutes and regained the lead at 48-45. Brown converted a three-point play, then buried a 3 before Jarin Stevenson’s dunk and the Tar Heels were up 50-45. North Carolina extended the lead to 60-51 before Georgia reeled it back in. Up next Georgia: Hosts Jacksonville on Monday. North Carolina: Hosts Marshall on Nov. 20.

item.title: Real Madrid star secures timely return to form on international duty
item.description: Real Madrid star secures timely return to form on international duty All of a Real Madrid persuasion will no doubt have been left relieved by the performance conjured up by attacking star Vinícius Jr. on the international front on Saturday. This comes after the 26-year-old secured a timely return to form. Wide-man Vinícius has of course come in for heavy criticism for the level of his form at club level this season, so much so that he appears to have been overtaken by summer signing Yan Diomandé in Real Madrid’s attacking pecking order. Nevertheless, the former Flamengo talent was in from the off earlier today, as Brazil locked horns with Japan in a friendly clash. In fact, the attacker was responsible for netting both of his country’s goals, courtesy of brilliant efforts from distance either side of the interval. Real Madrid’s fans, staff and players alike will now be hopeful of such excellence carrying over to club level over the weeks and months ahead… Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Ian Rush calls out bizarre Alexander Isak criticism after electric start rivals Haaland
item.description: Ian Rush calls out bizarre Alexander Isak criticism after electric start rivals Haaland Ian Rush has disagreed with the common consensus about Alexander Isak this season. The Swedish international has been accused, at various times this season, of not being actively involved during Liverpool games. But Alexander Isak is scoring – and that’s what matters! (Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images) As Rush was at pains to point out, the former Newcastle United hitman is scoring goals this season. Enough, at any rate, to put him in early contention with Manchester City’s Erling Haaland for the golden boot, with seven Premier League goals registered to the Norwegian’s nine – and in one fewer game to boot. “People say that Isak isn’t getting involved much but he’s scoring goals and that’s all that matters. The hardest thing in football is to score a goal and he’s only second to (Erling) Haaland,” the Liverpool legend told BBC Sport . It seems that no matter what the 27-year-old does in the famous red shirt, someone will have something negative to say about his performances. But the fact remains that Isak is managing to get on the scoresheet with some degree of frequency as part of a frontline that is far from cohesive at this stage. Can you imagine how many times he’ll be finding the back of the net once he finds a collective rhythm alongside Cody Gakpo and Bradley Barcola? Critics forget what Isak went through at Liverpool last term (Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images) One may reasonably be inclined to think that critics have forgotten how Isak had the debut season from hell at Liverpool following his move from Newcastle in the summer. The forward managed only 1,032 minutes across all competitions in Arne Slot’s final season in charge, between adductor issues and a broken fibula. 1,032 minutes, four goals and one assist. In 2026/27, the Swede has already racked up eight goals and an assist in 899 minutes of action (across all competitions). Far easier for Alexander Isak to build fluency when he’s spending a lot more time on the pitch early in the season and stringing a series of starts together from one game to the next.

item.title: Official: Brock Faber Returns to MN Wild Blue Line
item.description: Nick Wosika-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect The Minnesota Wild are in Boston on Saturday trying to add more points to their already gawdy total of 32, the most in both the Central Division and Western Conference. Entering tonight’s matchup, the Wild have a 98% chance of making the playoffs , according to multiple models and sportsbooks. Even more impressive, they’ve done it all without top-line defenseman, Brock Faber. The former Gopher fractured his skull on Sept. 25 when a puck hit him in the side of the head during the Wild’s preseason finale against Dallas. He had surgery two days later, spent three days at Regions Hospital and has missed all 21 regular season games since. Doctors cleared Faber to practice in early November. By Nov. 12, head coach John Hynes confirmed that the target date for his return was Saturday, but there were “no guarantees.” As recent as Friday, there were real doubts over whether or not Faber would hit that date, or wait Tuesday when the Wild return home against Nashville. Minnesota Wild activate Brock Faber for his season debut But then Saturday morning, the Wild made it official, activating Faber from injured reserve, and announcing on social media that the 24-year-old defenseman is back. Hynes confirmed the debut, according to Joe O’Donnell (Wild radio). Michael Russo (The Athletic) reported that Joel Eriksson Ek will play as well. The #mnwild has activated defenseman Brock Faber from Injured Reserve. — Minnesota Wild PR (@mnwildPR) November 14, 2026 we can think of exactly 7 reasons to be happy today — Minnesota Wild (@minnesotawild) November 14, 2026 Related: MN Wild Getting Healthier Again; Faber Back…? The defense pairs aren’t set yet. Russo listed two options , with Faber skating next to either Quinn Hughes or Jonas Brodin, and Olli Maatta and Zach Bogosian together on the third pair. A win against the Bruins would add to a 10-game point streak and mark seven straight road victories all without Brock Faber. What are MN Wild getting back with Faber’s return? Last season, the Maple Grove native had career highs of 15 goals and 51 points in 80 games, with 36 assists and a plus-18. His 15 goals led Wild defensemen and tied for 10th among all NHL defensemen. Faber averaged 24:41 of ice time, second on the team behind Hughes. He’s now in year two of an eight-year, $68 million contract that carries an $8.5 million cap hit through 2032-33. Faber and the Wild face the Bruins (13-5-1) tonight at 6 p.m. CT at TD Garden on Wild+ and Fubo. Russo reported that Jesper Wallstedt will start in goal against Jeremy Swayman. item.title: Minnesota Vikings’ Kirk Cousins Trade Features Interesting Twist
item.description: The Minnesota Vikings made a move to acquire quarterback Kirk Cousins from the Las Vegas Raiders at the NFL trade deadline, sending a third-round pick to the Raiders in return. The deal followed the Vikings’ miserable Week 9 Monday night loss to the Buffalo Bills, where Minnesota managed just six points in a 17-point defeat. Carson Wentz managed just 81 passing yards before being benched for Max Brosmer. That appeared to be the tipping point for the Vikings, who started the 2026 campaign 6-0 but have now lost two games in a row to watch their NFC North lead disappear. However, Minnesota had apparently reached a boiling before before the Bills loss, according to NFL insiders Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport. Minnesota Vikings tried to trade for Kirk Cousins earlier Oct 23, 2023; Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA; Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kirk Cousins (8) warms up before the game against the San Francisco 49ers at U.S. Bank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jeffrey Becker-USA TODAY Sports Evidently, the Vikings reached out to the Raiders before Monday night’s disaster. “The first time the Vikings reached out to the Raiders about a potential trade for Kirk Cousins was midday Monday, hours before Minnesota played the Bills on ‘Monday Night Football,’ league sources told ESPN and NFL Network,” Schefter and Rapoport wrote . “During that call, the Vikings made it clear to the Raiders that they wanted to see how Monday night went first before having any further conversations about Cousins, but they would be in touch if needed.” Obviously, things ended up going very south for the Vikings in that game, so that was when they ultimately decided to pull the trigger. Of course, Minnesota may have incidentally given Las Vegas more leverage in those trade discussions considering just how bad the Vikings looked under center on Monday, but a third-round pick seemed like a small price to pay for Minnesota. Cousins is now in his second stint with the Vikings after spending six years with the club between 2018 and 2023. The 38-year-old is certainly armed with an impressive stable of weapons in Minnesota, so we’ll see if he can ultimately lead the Vikings on a deep playoff run. item.description: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy (18) looks to throw the ball during a game against the Washington Commanders at MetLife Stadium, Nov 12, 2026, East Rutherford, NJ, USA. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect On Friday, John Harbaugh said the Giants had short and deep routes available on the late throws against Washington’s all-out pressure. I’d change the order of the decision for J.J. McCarthy. With a field goal still useful and the clock running out, decide before the snap which underneath throw can keep the drive alive. Take the deep ball when the look is right, not because pressure narrowed the quarterback’s time to think. The pressure itself didn’t defeat McCarthy all night. He went 8-for-14 for 155 yards against the blitz, according to Next Gen Stats via John Schmeelk’s Friday review . He also finished with a career-high 293 passing yards. In the final sequence a deep throw intended for Malik Nabers was intercepted with 25 seconds left, per the game recap . You can see a quarterback handle extra rushers well for most of a game and still want a better answer for that last situation. Separate the pressure answer from the clock answer “The ball’s got to come out fast,” Harbaugh said . He noted the offense couldn’t block everyone on the zero blitzes and said McCarthy made split-second choices. A receiver can be open further down the field without being the best throw for the situation. To me, the adjustment is to give McCarthy a short route he can choose at the line and a clear idea of which side he needs the catch to finish on. item.title: Alec Bohm makes sense for the Yankees at one guaranteed year
item.description: Oct 1, 2026; Cumberland, Georgia, USA; Philadelphia Phillies infielder Alec Bohm (28) looks on before game three of the Wildcard round for the 2026 MLB Playoffs at Truist Field. Mandatory Credit: Dale Zanine-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Alec Bohm is worth a call if the Yankees want a right-handed answer at third base. I wouldn’t sign him as the answer for all 162 games. My offer would be one guaranteed year, with Ryan McMahon still around to take most of the starts against right-handers and defend late when New York has a lead. MLB.com’s Mark Feinsand reported the Yankees’ interest , after Jon Heyman first reported it for the New York Post. Bryan Hoch’s Friday look at the roster says New York is open to adding at third. Neither report establishes a one-year offer. That’s the term I’d be willing to guarantee. Sep 30, 2026; Cumberland, Georgia, USA; Philadelphia Phillies first baseman Alec Bohm (28) celebrates in the dugout after hitting a solo home run against the Atlanta Braves in the tenth inning during game two of the Wildcard round for the 2026 MLB Playoffs at Truist Park. Mandatory Credit: Brett Davis-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Yankees would be buying the matchup, not the entire stat line Bohm finished last season with a .698 OPS. Look at his 2026 splits and you can see two different jobs inside that number: .816 against left-handers in 192 plate appearances and .644 against right-handers in 437. McMahon had a .509 OPS against lefties and .662 against righties. The gap that gives Bohm a job is on the left-handed side of the opposing rotation. There isn’t much evidence in these numbers to make him the default against righties. The fielding is a separate reason not to hand him the full job. Feinsand’s report cites a minus-nine Fielding Run Value in 2026. That’s one measure and a down year, not an exact bill for what will happen in the Bronx. But if New York adds Bohm for the bat, it should be comfortable replacing him for defense when that advantage has already been used and the game is on the line. 0 What do you think? Post a comment. A flexible third-base plan still has a price There will be days the likely second pitcher matters as much as the starter. If the opponent starts a lefty but can go to a right-hander in the fourth, I would keep the option to hit for Bohm later. If McMahon is on the bench and the tying run is on second, you’ve still got a left-handed bat and the ability to finish the game with him at third. Before making the offer, I’d also map out the rest of the bench. Two third basemen are easier to carry if somebody else can cover second and short without starting a chain of substitutions. Bohm’s experience at first helps, but with Ben Rice already there, those innings don’t carry the same value to the Yankees as they might to another club. You can make a case for paying more if you think Bohm’s .794 OPS after the All-Star break is the hitter you’ll get for a whole season.

item.description: The Los Angeles Rams are certainly facing an injury crisis at the wide receiver position. Puka Nacua, Davante Adams and Jordan Whittington are all on injured reserve, and while the Rams are 5-4 and still very much alive in the NFC playoff picture, their offense is on life support. Los Angeles did not add any wide receiver help at the NFL trade deadline, much to the chagrin of the fanbase. And in terms of free agency, the options are very thin at this time of year. However, Bleacher Report’s Moe Moton has identified a potential fit for Matthew Stafford and the Rams’ aerial attack: eight-year veteran receiver Darius Slayton. item.description: Rick Bowness will miss a second straight game due to an undisclosed health issue when the Blue Jackets play the Philadelphia Flyers on Nov. 14 at Nationwide Arena, and his return to the bench is uncertain as he undergoes medical evaluation. More: The Columbus Blue Jackets are still sputtering: Where's the beef? Blue Jackets president/general manager Don Waddell said Bowness, 71, is considered "day-to-day" until more is known. Bowness hasn't been ruled out for an upcoming four-game road trip that starts Nov. 17 against the New York Islanders , but won't travel with the team Oct. 16 when it heads to New York. "He's doing more testing on Monday," Waddell said. "He was actually here [at the arena] this morning for a little bit. That's a good sign. He met with the coaches and [all] that. We'll list him like a player, 'day-to-day,' but I've talked to him a lot. He's doing OK. He's just got some things that are affecting him that we need to figure out ... the doctors need to figure out." Bowness missed the Blue Jackets' 3-1 loss to the Tampa Bay Lightning on Oct. 12 at Nationwide Arena. Assistant coach Don Granato , former head coach of the Buffalo Sabres, handled the head coaching duties. Granato will again run the bench against the Flyers, while assistants Trent Vogelhuber, Jared Boll and goaltending coach Niklas Backstrom will handle their usual tasks. Waddell said the issue became noticeable recently, which led to Bowness getting checked out. "The last couple days, he wasn't feeling great," Waddell said. "He came in Thursday morning, and we told him to go home and get rest because he wasn't 'looking great, and from there we got our doctors involved and we're trying to figure out what's going on." Bowness left retirement to join the Blue Jackets in January 2026, taking over midseason for Dean Evason. His prior coaching job was with the Winnipeg Jets and he cited undisclosed family and health issues as the reason he stepped down from that head coaching role in April 2024. He twice stepped away from the Jets in 2023-24 for family and medical reasons. The first was after his wife, Judy, had a seizure and the second was for a minor medical procedure of his own. Upon joining the Blue Jackets, Bowness said he was physically up to returning as an NHL head coach and that his wife was just as eager for him to do it. item.title: Alexander Zverev’s Ex Makes Explosive New Allegations Amid ATP Finals
item.description: Germany's Alexander Zverev celebrates a win at the 2026 French Open. Getty Ahead of his quest for a third ATP Finals title in Turin, World No. 1 Alexander Zverev has been hit with a civil lawsuit over public misrepresentations by Brenda Patea, the mother of his child. According to Bounces’ Ben Rothenberg, the lawsuit — reportedly filed in Berlin on September 18 — centers on a recent L’Équipe interview in which Zverev claimed his “innocence has been proven,” two years after the conclusion of their criminal suit. The 2024 criminal case ended in a €200,000 settlement — €150,000 to the German state treasury and €50,000 to charities. In discontinuing the proceedings, the court explicitly noted the outcome was neither a conviction nor an acquittal, leaving no verdict on his guilt or innocence. As such, Patea felt that Zverev was in no position to claim his innocence had been proven. Alexander Zverev’s Legal Troubles The civil suit stemmed from Patea’s allegation that Zverev physically assaulted her during an argument in a Berlin apartment in May 2020. Per court records, she claimed he pushed her against a wall and strangled her with both hands, leaving her with throat pain and shortness of breath. Zverev has consistently denied all allegations of abuse. Shortly after the trial ended in 2024, Zverev lashed out when BBC’s Russell Fuller asked if he had “any reservations on your part that you came to a settlement and that you didn’t have a chance for the court in Berlin to say that you were innocent of all the charges?” As highlighted by Rothenberg, Zverev rejected the notion that he wasn’t innocent. “That’s what dropping the case is: that is innocence,” Zverev had said. “They’re not going to drop the case if you’re guilty at the end of the day. I don’t know what translations you have, but that’s what it means. Done. We move on. I never ever want to hear another question about the subject again. That goes out to everybody.” Patea is one of two ex-girlfriends to accuse Zverev of physical abuse, alongside Olga Sharypova. ATP Finals Begins Zverev, who won his first two career Grand Slams this year, faces Spanish prodigy Rafael Jodar in the group stage of the ATP Finals on Sunday. While Zverev and Carlos Alcaraz enter as the clear co-favorites, Zverev isn’t ready to underestimate Jodar, Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils. “I think we shouldn’t disrespect anybody,” Zverev said when asked if the rest of the field stood a chance, via ATP. “I don’t think about Carlos right now, but I think about these three young gentlemen because we have a very strong group and everybody shows that they know how to play tennis, otherwise they would not be here. “So my focus is on them at the moment and then we see what will happen later in the week.” This article was originally published on HEAVY The post Alexander Zverev’s Ex Makes Explosive New Allegations Amid ATP Finals appeared first on HEAVY .

item.title: Veron backs Lazio as surprise Scudetto contenders: ‘No team has shown more’
item.description: Veron backs Lazio as surprise Scudetto contenders: ‘No team has shown more’ Juan Sebastián Verón believes Lazio can win the Scudetto, insisting no team in Serie A has shown more than Gennaro Gattuso’s side this season. Speaking to SportWeek, via TuttoMercatoWeb , the former Lazio midfielder, now president of Estudiantes, says the Biancocelesti’s position at the top of the table is no fluke. “Why, is it forbidden?” Verón said. “Tell me who, at the start of this Serie A season, has shown they have something more than Lazio. I’ll answer for you: nobody. “The current table isn’t a quirk of fate. It reflects what we’ve seen so far. Things may change, and maybe some tiredness will creep into the legs of Gattuso’s players, but the foundations on which they’ve built their lead are solid, very solid.” ROME, ITALY – AUGUST 30: Davide Frattesi celebrates after scoring an opening goal during the Serie A match at Stadio Olimpico on August 30, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Marco Rosi – Getty Images) Verón on Lazio and Frattesi Lazio are unbeaten after 11 games and top on 29 points, their best-ever total at this stage. They’re one point ahead of Inter and two clear of Roma. Gattuso continues to insist that his only target is reaching 40 points. Verón won the Scudetto with the Biancocelesti in 2000, and he picked out Davide Frattesi as the player who excites him most. The midfielder, on loan from Inter, has four goals for Lazio this season and also scored in Italy’s 3-1 win over France on Thursday . “Who excites me most? If I close my eyes and think for a moment, I’d say Frattesi. In my opinion, he was an excellent midfielder even before joining Lazio, and he’s doing extraordinary things,” Verón added. “There are very few players in Italy who can get into the box like him. And he scores goals, which in football is never a minor detail.”
